install_tell: SaaS at server.lasso.security/gateway/v3. Two endpoints: /classify (read-only intent classification) and /classifix (mask/transform). LiteLLM hook chooses endpoint based on masking config. NestJS-style stack (UnauthorizedException / ISO timestamp in error bodies).
misconfig_patterns: API key in LiteLLM litellm_params persists to operator-side YAML
Masking-mode operators rely on /classifix to scrub PII; if endpoint fails open, the downstream LLM sees raw PII (verification gate, not Lasso-side bug)

active_probe.false_positive_check: JSON body must contain both 'name':'UnauthorizedException' AND 'message':'Invalid API key'

deployment_tells: DMARC p=reject with sp=none -- aggressive enforcement on parent, subdomain leniency
pivot_paths: POST /gateway/v3/classify with no key -- HTTP 401 with NestJS-shaped body
Investigate sp=none -- subdomain spoofability is the asymmetric posture

dmarc_posture.insight_80_placement: Series B+ (p=reject at pct=100); sp=none is the asymmetric tell -- parent locked, subdomains open

insight_82_status: CONFIRMED-WEAK (HTTP 401 with NestJS-shaped UnauthorizedException + Invalid API key; framework-default rather than vendor-name-literal, but population-distinctive when paired with /gateway/v3/ path)
